senses.gloss: Daṇḍa^1, brother of the Magadha king Daṇḍadhāra. § 11 (Parvasaṅgr.) I, 2, 544.--§ 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2681 (incarnation of the Asura Krodhahantṛ).--§ 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6992 (the same(?), son of Vidaṇḍa, present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).--§ 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 30, 1091 (ºñ ca Daṇḍadhārañ ca, vanquished by Bhīmasena on his digvijaya).--§ 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 18, †701 (his brother Daṇḍadhāra slain by Arjuna), †704 (slain by Arjuna).
Daṇḍa^2, a follower of Sūrya (the Sun). § 310b (Sūrya): III, 3, 198 (Māṭharāruṇa-Dºādyāḥ).
Daṇḍa^3, a Pāṇḍava warrior. § 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 56, 2740 (slain by Karṇa).
Daṇḍa^4 = Śiva (1000 names^1).
Daṇḍa^5 = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Daṇḍabāhu, a warrior of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2575.

Daṇḍadhāra^1, king of the Magadhas. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2682 (incarnation of the Asura Krodhavardhana).-§ 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6987 (the same(?), present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).--§ 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 30, 1091 (coming to the country of the Magadhas, Bhīmasena vanquished Daṇḍa and Daṇḍadhāra).--§ 554 (Sainyodyogap.): V, 4, 84.--§ 572 (Rathātirathasaṅkhyānap.): V, 166, 5764 (a ratha in the army of Duryodhana).--§ 605 (Karṇap.): VIII, 18, 687, 689, †695 (king of the Magadhas, brother of Daṇḍa, is slain by Arjuna; cf. Daṇḍasena). Cf. Girivrajeśvara (VIII, †696), Māgadha.
Daṇḍadhāra^2, son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2738.--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 56, 2727 (rescued Duryodhana); 83, 4262 (among ten sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra who are slain by Bhīmasena).

Daṇḍadhāra^3, various Pāṇḍava warriors. § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 23, 1000 (proceeded against Droṇa, description of his horses).--§ 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 6, 163 (has been slain by Droṇa).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 49, 2327 (a Pāñcālya, slain by Karṇa).
Daṇḍadhāra^4 = Śiva (1000 names^1).
Daṇḍagaurī, an Apsaras. § 336 (Indralokābhig.): III, 43, 1784 (among the Apsarases who danced in the palace of Indra).

Daṇḍaka^1, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 284 (Sahadeva): II, 31, 1169 (in the south, vanquished by Sahadeva on his digvijaya).--§ 772b (Pavanārjunasaṃv.): XIII, 154, 7223 (their kingdom had been destroyed by a brahman).

Daṇḍaka^2, a forest. § 479 (Pativratop.): III, 206, 13678 (munīnāṃ…yeshāṃ krodhāgnir adyāpi Dºe nopaśāmyati). --§ 771 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 152, 7178 (yeshāṃ kopāgnir adyāpi Dºe nopaśāmyati). Cf. next.

Daṇḍakāraṇya = Daṇḍaka^2. § 370 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 85, 8183.--§ 425 (Hanūmad-Bhīmasaṃv.): III, 147, 11198. --§ 527 (Rāmopākhyānap.): III, 277, 15985.--§ 530 (Viśvāvasumokshaṇa): III, 279, 16070.--§ 615k (Mahodara): IX, 39, 2255. Cf. the prec.
Daṇḍaketu, a prince. § 592 (Saṃśaptakavadhap.): VII, 23, 1015 (proceeded against Droṇa, description of his horses).
Daṇḍākhya, a tīrtha. § 370 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 85, 8157 (in Campā). Cf. Daṇḍārtta.
Daṇḍapāṇi^1 = Antaka: V, 5779 (iva); VI, 1952 (ºr ivāparaḥ).
Daṇḍapāṇi^2 = Śiva: VII, 9455.
Daṇḍārt(t)a, a tīrtha. § 370 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 84, 8141 (in Campā, PCR. has Daṇḍaparṇa). Cf. Daṇḍākhya.
Daṇḍasena, a prince. § 11 (Parvasaṅgr.): I, 2, 544 (ºsya vadhaḥ, seems to allude to VIII, ch. 18, where is read Daṇḍadhāra; v. Daṇḍadhāra^1).
Daṇḍimuṇḍa = Śiva (1000 names^1).
Daṇḍin^1, son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2738.
Daṇḍin^2 = Yama: I, 7077 (Pitṛrājaḥ).
